text:
olivia: Hey team — heads-up. I hit a token refresh loop with the `nextjs-demo` (examples/devex-next-langchain) while testing ephemeral browser keys + SDK v0.9.2. The app keeps spamming `/v1/auth/refresh` every ~1s and UX freezes.

olivia: Repro steps: 1) git clone examples/devex-next-langchain, 2) yarn && yarn dev, 3) sign in with demo key, 4) open chat and send a prompt.

olivia: Console/log snippet:
```
[client] fetch /v1/chat  -> 401
[client] trigger token refresh
[client] fetch /v1/chat  -> 401
[client] trigger token refresh
[client] fetch /v1/chat  -> 401
... repeats every second
```

maria: ugh. can you paste the browser console stack? are you using the `useDevexAuth` helper from the examples or a custom hook?

olivia: using the example's `useDevexAuth` hook exactly. browser console shows `Error: 401 unauthorized -> token refresh triggered` repeated. also noticed client config in the example sets `retries: 0` for auth endpoints.

josh: this sounds like the refresh race we've seen. simultaneous requests all see expired token and each triggers a refresh flow. we shipped a debounce/single-flight fix in rc v0.9.3 — can you try upgrading to 0.9.3? as a short-term workaround set `client.allowConcurrentRefresh = false` on the browser client.

olivia: quick test — bumped to 0.9.3. Much better, but still occasionally one extra refresh when chat does rapid polling. i hacked a tiny single-flight wrapper and it fixed it locally:
```
let refreshInFlight = null;
async function refreshToken() {
  if (refreshInFlight) return await refreshInFlight;
  refreshInFlight = fetch('/v1/auth/refresh').then(r => r.json()).finally(() => { refreshInFlight = null });
  return await refreshInFlight;
}
```

sam: can we add an e2e that simulates concurrent requests in the examples? this would have caught it. i'll open an issue and include a reproducible harness under examples/eval-harness.

deploy-bot: CI created issue #842: "NextJS demo auth refresh race" and kicked off e2e job 4821 :gear:

josh: i'll follow up with an SDK patch that ensures single-flight refresh across tabs too (using BroadcastChannel fallback). also noted server-side retry backoff default was 100ms; increasing to 500ms cut down the flapping in my local stress tests.

maria: olivia — any other onboarding friction you ran into while trying the example? we should update the README to explicitly state the minimum SDK version and env var names so new devs don't run into this.

olivia: good call. i'll open a docs PR: update README, add a short troubleshooting section ("auth refresh loops"), and add the tiny repro harness under examples/eval-harness/auth-refresh-race. thanks y'all :pray!
